name: Pike Push-Up
instructions: Start with your hands and feet on the floor and your hips high, so your body forms an inverted V.
Bend your elbows and lower the top of your head toward the floor between your hands.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips high throughout to keep the load on your shoulders.
image_prompt_scene: Hips high in an inverted V with the hands and feet on the floor.
